title: Andrej Karpathy — Let's build GPT from scratch
summary: A hands-on, line-by-line walkthrough of how GPT actually works.
body: A 2-hour video walkthrough in which Andrej Karpathy builds a working GPT model from scratch in Python, explaining every line of code as he goes. It covers tokenisation, the attention mechanism, transformers, and training — all in one sitting. This is the resource for anyone who wants to go beyond conceptual explanations and actually see the maths made concrete.
